gloss: to indicate; to point to; to suggest

definitions.gloss: to point to; to indicate; to show
definitions.explanation: To physically point at or toward something to identify it. A compound of {指|さ}す (to point) and {示|しめ}す (to show).

definitions.gloss: to indicate; to suggest; to point to (abstract)
definitions.explanation: To show or suggest a direction, conclusion, or meaning in an abstract sense. Common in academic, analytical, and news contexts.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}の{場所|ばしょ}を{指|ゆび}で{指|さ}し{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: I pointed to the location on the map with my finger.

examples.japanese: {方角|ほうがく}を{指|さ}し{示|しめ}して{道|みち}を{教|おし}えた。
examples.english: I pointed in the direction and gave directions.

examples.japanese: コンパスの{針|はり}が{北|きた}を{指|さ}し{示|しめ}している。
examples.english: The compass needle is pointing north.

examples.japanese: このデータは{経済|けいざい}の{回復|かいふく}を{指|さ}し{示|しめ}している。
{研究|けんきゅう}{結果|けっか}は{新|あたら}しい{治療法|ちりょうほう}の{可能性|かのうせい}を{指|さ}し{示|しめ}している。
examples.english: The research results point to the possibility of a new treatment method.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}は{同|おな}じ{過|あやま}ちを{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す{危険性|きけんせい}を{指|さ}し{示|しめ}している。
examples.english: History points to the danger of repeating the same mistakes.

notes:
USAGE:
More emphatic and deliberate than {指|さ}す alone. Sense 2 (abstract indication) is very common in news, academic papers, and formal writing. Often used when data, evidence, or trends suggest a particular conclusion.

GRAMMAR:
Godan verb conjugating on the す row. Takes を for the object being pointed to or indicated.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指|さ}す: to point — simpler, more everyday
- {示|しめ}す: to show, to indicate — broader meaning, not limited to pointing
- {暗示|あんじ}する: to hint, to imply — less direct, suggests something indirectly
